summary: Record the completed Windows 11 VirtIO system-disk install using the existing second CD driver-disc workflow. API impact: existing contract; no API behavior changed.

guide.reason: The existing driver-disc workflow was exercised successfully; no operator instructions changed.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. This is QA evidence for existing VM create, media and console operations.

roadmap.reason: Verification closes an existing acceptance debt without changing roadmap scope or delivery order.

state.reason: QA documentation only; the disposable VM and its disks were deleted.

verification.method: On a disposable nested lab, a Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC fresh VM had the install ISO and virtio-win 0.1.302 on separate CD drives. Setup showed no disk until the Red Hat VirtIO SCSI driver was loaded from the driver disc, then exposed the 64 GiB VirtIO disk, completed installation and rebooted to OOBE. The VM was stopped and deleted with its disks. Raw captures remain ignored local evidence.
